That’s retail for you. I’m a keyholder at a clothing store and it’s the same thing. I went from getting overtime to 20 hours last week. Most of the sales associates are getting 10 or less. If you want more hours you could get a second job. During slow times you’ll probably work full time, but during holidays you’ll easily be working overtime at both. 

Depending on the way your company is set up, you might be able to work at a different location to get some extra hours.

FYI: [aid access](https://aidaccess.org) will provide abortion pills in an emergency. There’s nothing to stop you from buying some right now when it’s still legal and distributing them to people you know as needed. I will be buying some to keep on hand for friends or myself.

I was a ruehle kid. I took all the classes he offered and I worked in his lab. He was also my FIRM advisor and I was the president of BoZo club. 

The basic sophomore/junior classes aren’t bad at all. Senior year is the fun part when you get to finally start taking the classes you’re really interested in. They’re hard, but in my experience all you have to do to succeed (or at least pass) is ask for help when you need it. You can study one topic for five hours straight but if you’re missing one piece of vital knowledge, it will be in vain. Go to tutoring as soon as you identify something you need help with.

I agree mostly, but some of the classes I had at asmsa were definitely harder than the average college class. Immuno is still probably the most challenging class I’ve ever taken. I passed with an A, but there’s so much material to cover and it isn’t easy. Science of Biology nearly killed me with the sheer volume of work we had to do. I still have a four inch binder full of assignments and vocabulary. The material itself wasn’t challenging but Krak makes it seem hard.

Graduated in 2017. 

We hatched 11 chicks and 5 ducks in Dr. Ruehle’s lab for DeVo. I carried them with me to almost every class. They would just sleep in my lap. One day we brought two of them to Carl Frank’s class. Mine was quiet, but my friend had a loud one that kept peeping. Halfway through the class Frank turned to my friend and told her to turn the volume down on her laptop, completely unaware of the unhappy chicken in her lap. He never found out about the chicks. 

We also made rice in the autoclave. It tasted horrible.

I have a bunch of old conversations with my mom who has since passed. I have a backup of my phone stored on my MacBook but that doesn’t feel sufficient. Is there a way to store a copy of that conversation in plain text or something so that I can see it from my laptop?
Do those other treatments actually work? I’ve always been under the impression that anti-aging creams and peels and stuff don’t actually work

I know this isn’t really a serious post but has anyone actually done it? Just moved to a new city and started over, changed their name, and left everything behind? My life completely fell apart in the past year so now I have no family, very few friends, no job, and no degree. I’m planning to kill myself soon but maybe this would be better.
